description: TAURAS – The Algorithmic Trading Hackathon Organised by Revat Crypto Fund Build. Optimise. Compete. Generate Alpha. TAURAS is a national-level algorithmic trading hackathon focused on developing quantitative trading strategies for cryptocurrency markets. It challenges participants to combine programming, mathematics, statistical modelling, and financial intelligence t o build algorithms capable of identifying market opportunities and generating alpha. Participants will go beyond conventional coding challenges and experience the fundamentals of quantitative trading, strat egy development, portfolio management, and risk optimisation. Competition Tracks & Segments Participants can compete across five specialized trading tracks: Segment A – Discretionary: Develop trading strategies based on market analysis, human judgment, and decision-making. Segment B – Systematic: Build rule-based, algorithmic trading strategies using quantitative models and market data. Segment C – MM/HFT (Market Making / High-Frequency Trading): Develop algorithms for liquidity provision, spread management, and high-speed trading. Segment D – Arbitrage: Build strategies that identify and exploit price differences across markets or exchanges. Segment E – DEX / On-Chain: Develop automated trading strategies using decentralized exchanges and blockchain-based protocols. The ultimate objective is to build an algorithm that can analyse market behaviour, make intelligent trading decisions, and perform consistently under dynamic market conditions. Don't just trade the market. Build the intelligence that trades it.

raw.details:
TAURAS – The Algorithmic Trading Hackathon

Organised by Revat Crypto Fund

Build. Optimise. Compete. Generate Alpha.

TAURAS is a national-level algorithmic trading hackathon focused on developing quantitative trading strategies for cryptocurrency markets. It challenges participants to combine programming, mathematics, statistical modelling, and financial intelligence to build algorithms capable of identifying market opportunities and generating alpha.

Participants will go beyond conventional coding challenges and experience the fundamentals of quantitative trading, strategy development, portfolio management, and risk optimisation.

Competition Tracks & Segments

Participants can compete across five specialized trading tracks:

  • Segment A – Discretionary: Develop trading strategies based on market analysis, human judgment, and decision-making.

  • Segment B – Systematic: Build rule-based, algorithmic trading strategies using quantitative models and market data.

  • Segment C – MM/HFT (Market Making / High-Frequency Trading): Develop algorithms for liquidity provision, spread management, and high-speed trading.

  • Segment D – Arbitrage: Build strategies that identify and exploit price differences across markets or exchanges.

  • Segment E – DEX / On-Chain: Develop automated trading strategies using decentralized exchanges and blockchain-based protocols.

The ultimate objective is to build an algorithm that can analyse market behaviour, make intelligent trading decisions, and perform consistently under dynamic market conditions.

Don't just trade the market. Build the intelligence that trades it.
